name: Queensland Rail Travel student fares
summary: Discounted long-distance rail fares in Queensland for full-time secondary and tertiary students aged 16 and over.
key: Save up to 40% off the full adult AChoice rail fare on Queensland Rail Travel network services.
who: 16 years and over enrolled full-time in accredited secondary or tertiary education with approved identification.
catches: Concession cards used to buy discounted tickets must be carried while travelling.
Upgrades to Sleeper or RailBed fares cost extra.

evidence.quote: The 40% discount is off the full adult AChoice rail fare on Queensland Rail Travel network services.
